OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

ORKL_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the ORKL API.

ORKL_IMPORT_START_DATE.description: How far back to look on the first import (e.g. 'P30D' for 30 days, 'P6M' for 6 months).

ORKL_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP marking level applied to created STIX objects.

ORKL_THREAT_ACTOR_AS_INTRUSION_SET.description: Create ORKL threat actors as Intrusion Sets (true) or as Threat Actors (false).

ORKL_INGEST_TOOLS.description: Create Tool entities from the threat actors' tools. Disabled by default: the ORKL feed does not distinguish malware from tools, so enabling this will create Tool entities for what are in fact malware families.
